text.en:
24th. JULY, 2006 No. S 77

DISASTER MANAGEMENT ORDER, 2006 {S 26/06) NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT UNDER SECTION 1{1) In exercise of the power conferred by subsection ( 1) of section 1 of the Disaster Management Order, 2006, the Senior Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. August, 2006 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 23rd. day of Jamadilakhir, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 19th. day of July, 2006.
